summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on optimizing ClickHouse database access for the operations team. Initially, [p1] questioned whether it was better to provide a full account (which requires time and configuration copying) or request minimal changes, noting that the entire operation team currently accesses ClickHouse in read-only mode.
[me] advised removing server-side settings and subsequently made a fix on '04'. This resolution allowed [p1]'s system to function correctly without needing a restart. The issue had been troubling someone for three weeks.
decisions: The ClickHouse access method was resolved by making a configuration change (fix on 04) that did not require restarting the service.
